title: VendPoint Machine Locks under a Credit Hold — Credit Department Notice
content:
Credit department notice on how a credit hold acts on machines of the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program.

1. When the customer's Commercial Credit Account is placed on hold, every active machine of the customer is locked; on a model whose credit hold vending rule is safety items only, items in the model's credit hold safety categories keep vending while locked, and on a model whose rule is lock machine nothing vends.
2. A machine is unlocked only when the customer's Commercial Credit Account status is active again.
3. Locking never stops restocking of the items that keep vending, and never changes the minimum term.

### Evidence for point 2

The status that decides an unlock is the status of the customer's Commercial Credit Account as the system record shows it before the unlock, for the same customer that holds the machine.

### What a locked machine does

| Model's credit hold vending rule | While locked |
|---|---|
| safety items only | Items in the credit hold safety categories keep vending and keep being restocked; other items do not vend |
| lock machine | Nothing vends |

### Basis questions

**Does the minimum term stop running while a machine is locked?** No; locking never changes the minimum term.

**Can a locked machine be unlocked while the account is still on hold?** No; a machine is unlocked only when the account status is active again.
